skills.name: Agile
skills.subtitle: Movement bonus
skills.text: All of your ships have +1 movement.

skills.name: Ambitious
skills.subtitle: 3 extra actions
skills.text: Once per turn you may take an additional action, then put a token on this card. If this card has three tokens on it, discard it.

skills.name: Brilliant
skills.subtitle: Research bonus
skills.text: At the start of your turn, you may gain 2 Research.

skills.name: Brutal
skills.subtitle: Combat with advantage
skills.text: For Combat rolls, roll twice and use the lower number.

skills.name: Calculating
skills.subtitle: Controlled scrapping
skills.text: When a ship is placed in your scrapyard, choose its ship number.

skills.name: Clever
skills.subtitle: Flexible modification
skills.text: After reconfiguring, you may increase or decrease the ship number by 1.

skills.name: Composed
skills.subtitle: Reduce dominance for research
skills.text: Once per turn, you may lose 1 Dominance and gain 3 Research.

skills.name: Cunning
skills.subtitle: Extra ship ability
skills.text: Once per turn, you may use one ship ability a second time.

skills.name: Curious
skills.subtitle: Bonus peaceful move
skills.text: At the end of your turn, if you did not Attack or Conquer, gain an additional Move or Research action.

skills.name: Dangerous
skills.subtitle: Destroy your attacker
skills.text: When you defend, before players roll combat dice, you can decide to destroy both ships (there is no dominance effect).

skills.name: Devious
skills.subtitle: Slingshot past enemies
skills.text: You may move your ships through enemy ships. These spaces do not count towards your movement.

skills.name: Ferocious
skills.subtitle: Combat bonus
skills.text: -1 to your Combat rolls.

skills.name: Flexible
skills.subtitle: Adjust a ship
skills.text: Once per turn, you may increase or decrease one of your ship numbers by 1.

skills.name: Hostile
skills.subtitle: Extra action for destruction
skills.text: The first time you destroy an enemy ship each turn, gain 1 action.

skills.name: Industrious
skills.subtitle: Extra deployment
skills.text: Gain an additional Deploy action each turn.

skills.name: Ingenious
skills.subtitle: Conquer from corners
skills.text: When Conquering, you may use spaces diagonal to a planet.

skills.name: Intelligent
skills.subtitle: Flexible conquering
skills.text: When Conquering, you may add or subtract 1 from the planet number.

skills.name: Patient
skills.subtitle: Delayed tactics
skills.text: Whenever you take a Tactic, you may instead store it. At the end of each of your turns, you may play a stored Tactic. When you take this Skill, you may take and store a Tactic.

skills.name: Pioneering
skills.subtitle: Conquer with research
skills.text: You may use your Research number in place of one of your ship numbers when Conquering.

skills.name: Plundering
skills.subtitle: Destruction is research
skills.text: The first time you destroy an enemy ship each turn, gain 3 Research.

skills.name: Precocious
skills.subtitle: Accelerated breakthrough
skills.text: Your Research resets at 4, 5, or 6.

skills.name: Prideful
skills.subtitle: Accelerated domination
skills.text: Your Dominance resets at 4, 5, or 6. When a player destroys one of your ships, they may take this card from you.

skills.name: Profiteering
skills.subtitle: Missiles from conquering
skills.text: When you take a card for Conquering, you may instead gain 1 Missile.

skills.name: Rational
skills.subtitle: Fixed combat
skills.text: Your Combat rolls are 3.

skills.name: Ravenous
skills.subtitle: Dominance amplification
skills.text: The first time you destroy an enemy ship each turn, gain 1 additional Dominance.

skills.name: Resourceful
skills.subtitle: Sacrifice for action
skills.text: Once per turn, you may destroy one of your ships and gain 1 Action.

skills.name: Righteous
skills.subtitle: Irreducible dominance
skills.text: You cannot lose Dominance. You cannot gain Research.

skills.name: Ruthless
skills.subtitle: Weaken your enemies
skills.text: The first time you destroy an enemy ship each turn, you may disable one of the enemy's Skills until the start of your next turn.

skills.name: Steadfast
skills.subtitle: Move more than once
skills.text: Your ships can move or move/attack more than once per turn (each move counts as an action).

skills.name: Stealthy
skills.subtitle: Isolated deployment
skills.text: You may deploy to any space that is not adjacent to a ship.

skills.name: Strategic
skills.subtitle: Combat support bonus
skills.text: During combat, if your ship is adjacent to one or more friendly ships, -2 to your Combat roll.

skills.name: Stubborn
skills.subtitle: Strong defence
skills.text: When you are attacked, ties go in your favour and you destroy your attacker if you win (and gain dominance).

skills.name: Tactical
skills.subtitle: Bonus short move
skills.text: Once per turn, you may move/attack 1 space with a ship even if it's already moved.

skills.name: Talented
skills.subtitle: Get more skills
skills.text: You can have up to 5 Skills.

skills.name: Tyrannical
skills.subtitle: Conquer with dominance
skills.text: You may use your Dominance number as an additional ship number when Conquering.

tactics.name: Aggression
tactics.subtitle: Add dominance
tactics.notes: Removed in stolksdorf CE (replaced by Show of Force); kept in the print edition.

tactics.name: Black Market
tactics.subtitle: Gain missiles
tactics.notes: stolksdorf name: Black Market Cache. Its yaml says 1 missile, Cards.md and print edition say 2.

tactics.name: Change of Heart
tactics.subtitle: Choose a skill
tactics.text: Search the Skill deck and take a card of your choosing, then shuffle the deck.

tactics.name: Momentum
tactics.subtitle: Take a bonus turn
tactics.text: Immediately take another turn, but with 2 actions instead of 3 (treat it as a brand-new turn).

tactics.name: Plan Ahead
tactics.subtitle: Become the missile
tactics.text: Until the end of your next turn, all your combat rolls are 1.

tactics.name: Sabotage
tactics.subtitle: Limit enemy action
tactics.text: Every opponent's next turn has 1 fewer action.
tactics.notes: Original: all other players discard a Command card.

tactics.name: Show of Force
tactics.subtitle: Target destroyed
tactics.text: Destroy any one ship. Gain 1 Dominance.

tactics.name: Unveil the Fleet
tactics.subtitle: Destroy & reroll ships
tactics.text: Destroy all your ships. You may reroll any ships in your scrapyard once. Deploy any number of ships.

tactics.name: Warp Gate
tactics.subtitle: Teleportation system
tactics.text: Place the Warp Gate tokens on two different spaces on the board. Any player may consider those spaces adjacent.
tactics.notes: stolksdorf name: Hypernet Gate, where only players who played it may use the link.

expansion.name: Expansion
expansion.subtitle: Expand your fleet
expansion.text: Immediately roll a reserve ship and put it in orbital position on a planet with one of your cubes or in your scrapyard.
expansion.notes: Original: 8 cards shuffled into the Gambit deck. CE: separate deck sized to player count.

original_command.name: Agile
original_command.subtitle: Movement bonus
original_command.text: All of your ships have +1 movement.

original_command.name: Arrogant
original_command.subtitle: Extra action for the most ships
original_command.text: If at the start of your turn you have more ships on the map than any other player, take 1 extra action.

original_command.name: Brilliant
original_command.subtitle: Research bonus
original_command.text: Add 2 to your research automatically at the start of your turn.

original_command.name: Cerebral
original_command.subtitle: Reduce dominance for research
original_command.text: Once per turn as a free action, you may reduce your dominance by 1 and gain 3 research.

original_command.name: Clever
original_command.subtitle: Controlled modification
original_command.text: Whenever you would roll a ship die, choose the ship number instead.

original_command.name: Conformist
original_command.subtitle: Extra action for matching ships
original_command.text: If at the start of your turn 2 or more of your ships on the map have the same number, take 1 extra action.

original_command.name: Cruel
original_command.subtitle: Force opponent to re-roll
original_command.text: When you attack or defend, you can choose to have your opponent re-roll once.

original_command.name: Cunning
original_command.subtitle: Extra ship ability
original_command.text: Once per turn, you may use one of your ship’s abilities a second time as a free action.

original_command.name: Curious
original_command.subtitle: Bonus peaceful move
original_command.text: Each turn, get 1 extra move action for free, as long as you do not attack any other player during your entire turn.
original_command.notes: Second-printing errata (designer, BGG thread 1087563). First printing: 'Each turn, get 1 extra move action for free (you cannot use it to attack).'

original_command.name: Dangerous
original_command.subtitle: Destroy your attacker
original_command.text: When you defend, before players roll combat dice, you can decide to destroy both ships (there is no dominance effect).

original_command.name: Eager
original_command.subtitle: Free deployment
original_command.text: Deploy does not use up one of your actions.

original_command.name: Energetic
original_command.subtitle: Move more than once
original_command.text: Your ships can move or move/attack more than once per turn (each move counts as an action).

original_command.name: Ferocious
original_command.subtitle: Combat bonus
original_command.text: Subtract 1 from every weapons or defences combat roll.

original_command.name: Flexible
original_command.subtitle: Adjust a ship
original_command.text: Once per turn, you may change one of your ship dice up or down by 1 as a free action.

original_command.name: Ingenious
original_command.subtitle: Construct from corners
original_command.text: Each of your ships diagonally adjacent to a planet may be counted towards the construct action.

original_command.name: Intelligent
original_command.subtitle: Flexible construction
original_command.text: You can construct on a planet when you have an orbital total 1 higher or 1 lower than the planet’s number.

original_command.name: Nomadic
original_command.subtitle: Transport between neighbouring planets
original_command.text: Once per turn, spend an action to relocate one of your ships in orbital position to another orbital position on a directly adjacent planet.

original_command.name: Plundering
original_command.subtitle: Destruction is research
original_command.text: If you destroy one or more enemy ships on your turn, increase your research by 3.

original_command.name: Precocious
original_command.subtitle: Accelerated research breakthroughs
original_command.text: Gain an advance card when research = 4 or higher (instead of 6).

original_command.name: Rational
original_command.subtitle: Combat rolls fixed at 3
original_command.text: Instead of rolling for weapons and defences, all of your combat die rolls are considered to be 3.

original_command.name: Ravenous
original_command.subtitle: Dominance amplification
original_command.text: When you destroy an enemy ship, dominance +2; when one of your ships is destroyed, dominance -2.

original_command.name: Relentless
original_command.subtitle: Re-roll in combat
original_command.text: When you attack or defend, you can roll again once after your opponent rolls.

original_command.name: Resourceful
original_command.subtitle: Sacrifice a ship to gain 1 action
original_command.text: Once per turn, take one of your ships from the map to your scrapyard, reroll it, and gain 1 action for that turn.

original_command.name: Righteous
original_command.subtitle: Irreducible dominance
original_command.text: Your dominance is not reduced when one of your ships is destroyed.

original_command.name: Scrappy
original_command.subtitle: Re-roll your die rolls
original_command.text: On your turn only, you may reroll all of your die rolls a second time (ship and weapons die rolls).

original_command.name: Stealthy
original_command.subtitle: Deploy to isolated spaces
original_command.text: You have the option of deploying to any space that is not next to another ship.

original_command.name: Strategic
original_command.subtitle: Combat support bonus
original_command.text: Any of your ships directly adjacent to another one of your ships receives a -2 to every combat roll.
original_command.notes: Revised-edition text (as on Board Game Arena). The 1st printing added "(you can consider an attacker to be in either square)"; the revision dropped it, so an attacker counts only from the square it attacked from (BGG thread 2774280).

original_command.name: Stubborn
original_command.subtitle: Strong defence
original_command.text: When you are attacked, ties go in your favour and you destroy your attacker if you win (and gain dominance).

original_command.name: Tactical
original_command.subtitle: Bonus short move
original_command.text: Once per turn as a free action, move a ship a total of 1 space (you can attack with the move).

original_command.name: Tyrannical
original_command.subtitle: Reduce research for dominance
original_command.text: Once per turn as a free action, you may reduce your research by 1 and gain 1 dominance.

original_command.name: Warlike
original_command.subtitle: Extra action for destruction
original_command.text: When you destroy 1 or more enemy ships on your turn, you gain 1 extra action for that turn.

original_gambit.name: Expansion
original_gambit.subtitle: Add a ship to your fleet
original_gambit.text: Immediately roll an expansion ship and put it in orbital position on a planet with one of your cubes or in your scrapyard.

original_gambit.name: Momentum
original_gambit.subtitle: Take a bonus 2 action turn
original_gambit.text: Immediately take another turn, but with 2 actions instead of 3 (treat it as a brand-new turn).

original_gambit.name: Reorganisation
original_gambit.subtitle: Immediately reroll any or all of your ships
original_gambit.text: Place each rerolled ship either in orbital position on a planet that has one of your cubes, or in your scrapyard.

original_gambit.name: Relocation
original_gambit.subtitle: Immediately move a cube
original_gambit.text: Move another player’s cube to a planet without one of their cubes.

original_gambit.name: Sabotage
original_gambit.subtitle: Remove command cards
original_gambit.text: All other players must immediately choose and discard one of their command cards.
